class.name: ProceduralRoot3D
class.brief_description: The node a script generates a level in, from [PackedScene]s you can edit and save like any scene.

method.name: _generate
method.description: Builds the level. Called by [method generate], after everything that was generated before has been freed. Use [method add_part] to make the parts. If this has to wait for something (a [code]await[/code]), turn on [member async_generation] and call [method finish_generation] when it is over.

method.name: add_part
method.description: Makes an instance of [param scene] as a generated child of [param parent] (this node, or a node under it, if [code]null[/code]) at [param transform], and sets [param properties] (name: value) on its root. The root of the scene must be a [Node3D]. Returns the new node.

method.name: clear_generated
method.description: Frees everything that was generated: every child (of this node or of the nodes the scene owns under it) that has no owner.

method.name: finish_generation
method.description: Ends a generating that was started with [member async_generation] on, and emits [signal generated].

method.name: generate
method.description: Frees what was generated and runs [method _generate]. Emits [signal generated] when it is done (at once, or when [method finish_generation] is called if [member async_generation] is on).

method.name: get_generated_part
method.description: The generated node that [param node] is, or is inside of (the root of the part it belongs to), or [code]null[/code] if it was not generated by a [ProceduralRoot3D].

method.name: get_part_scenes
method.description: The paths of the scenes the generated parts were made from.

method.name: is_generated_node
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param node] has no owner and is below a [ProceduralRoot3D]: it was generated.

method.name: is_generating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between the start of [method generate] and [signal generated].

method.name: reload_part_scene
method.description: Updates the generated parts made from the scene at [param path] to the scene as it is now, as [member part_reload] says. The editor calls this after it saves a scene.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [method generate] does not end when [method _generate] returns: the script calls [method finish_generation] when it is done (use it when [method _generate] has an [code]await[/code]).
Editor button: frees what was generated.
If [code]true[/code], the level is generated when the scene is opened in the editor (it needs a [code]@tool[/code] script).
What happens in the editor when a scene a part was made from is saved.

signal.name: part_scene_reloaded
signal.description: Emitted when the generated parts made from the scene at [param path] were updated after it was saved.

constants.constant: The saved scene replaces each copy where it stands (same transform and name, the properties given to [method add_part] set again).
Everything is generated again. Use it when the generator depends on what is in the scene (its size, markers in it).
Nothing changes until you generate again.
